item.title: No arrests made as investigation continues in death of Washington trooper
item.description: It has been six weeks since a Washington State Patrol trooper died while on duty, and the investigation into her death continues.

item.title: WA picks EV charger projects to receive federal funding
item.description: Five awardees are on track to receive a combined $12.1 million in federal funding to build and operate electric vehicle charging stations at 14 locations along highways in Washington state.

item.title: Inside Super Bowl week’s concerts, parties and celebrity scene heading into big game
item.description: Super Bowl week will unfold across several days in the Bay Area, with the game itself serving as the final act in a tightly coordinated mix of sports, music, media and celebrity appearances.

item.title: Clark County Prosecuting Attorney’s Office seeks to sideline Judge Tsering Cornell from cases dealing with violent, sexual offenses
item.description: Over the past month, Clark County deputy prosecutors have sought to sideline Superior Court Judge Tsering Cornell from overseeing dozens of cases involving violent and sexual offenses.

item.title: Seahawks going up for sale after Super Bowl
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks’ appearance in the Super Bowl on Feb. 8 could be the last game for the Allen family as owners of the team.

item.title: Bri Hust of Skyview takes top honors as Skyview girls claim another 4A district girls bowling team title
item.description: Bri Hust wasn’t thinking about winning a district title Friday at the 4A girls bowling district tournament.

item.title: Clark County health officials say person with measles visited a second location in Ridgefield
item.description: Clark County Public Health on Friday identified a second location in Ridgefield visited by a person with a confirmed case of measles.

item.title: Knicks power past Blazers 127-97
item.description: Jalen Brunson scored 26 points and OG Anunoby added 24 points as the New York Knicks extended their winning streak to five games with a 127-97 victory over the Portland Trail Blazers.

item.title: Grace Beshears of Ridgefield, R.A. Long team capture titles at 2A girls bowling district tournament
item.description: Grace Beshears of Ridgefield won the individual title and R.A. Long capture the team crown as 2A Greater St. Helens League bowlers dominated the Class 2A-1A District 4 girls bowling tournament Friday at Triangle Bowl in Longview.
